builtFrom: USDA FNDDS Survey Foods, release 2024-10-31 (survey coverage 1/1/2021..12/31/2023)
generatedNote: Generated by scripts/build-fndds.js (npm run build:fndds) from the USDA FoodData Central Survey (FNDDS) bulk JSON release dated 2024-10-31. Values are per 100 g. Keys: c=foodCode, d=description, cat=WWEIA category, k=kcal, p=protein g, f=fat g, cb=carbohydrate g, po=[[portionDescription, gramWeight], ...]. A null nutrient means USDA ships no value for that food; 0 is a real measured zero. This file is deterministic - rebuilding from the same release reproduces it byte for byte.
